apparatus.note: The original ASV 1901 apparatus reports some authorities insert a statement about the moving of the water and an angel (traditional verse 5:4).
Most of the ancient authorities omit John 7:53–8:11. Those which contain it vary much from each other.

scope_note: Selected high-impact original ASV 1901 marginal notes, with 271 complete digital USX note elements retained in untouched source file and historical pages. No modern textual-critical assessment.
